scientific_integrity: An exact algebraic proof supplies the all-order theorem; 144 finite exact assertions are corroborative only. Later same-object spectral research is acknowledged and an equivalent unindexed determinant identity remains possible. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The actuator lies at an endpoint of one exceptional edge; no arbitrary actuator positions, large-order uniform conditioning or finite-horizon dynamical control-energy theorem is proved. The signed exceptional weight is an algebraic extension, not a positive-conductance network.
title: Exact Kalman determinant of a cycle with one exceptional edge
